methods.scaling_rule: required = minimum x team games played / 162
methods.scaling_text: Each minimum is a full-season (162-game) bar set by the owner after reviewing the reliability study's curves; the study did not choose them. The bar scales with the team games played by the player's current team: required = minimum x team games played / 162. For example, after 81 team games the AVG bar is 251 plate appearances.
methods.traded_players: A traded player's sample counts every game he played this season, for any team, and is held to the bar of the team he played for most recently.
methods.position_note: Hitter positions use the listed primary position (IF = 1B/2B/3B/SS, OF = LF/CF/RF/OF, C/DH = C/DH). Pitcher roles (Starters vs. Relievers) are classified from appearances started (50%+ starts = Starter).
methods.ranking: Highest leads for counting and positive rate stats; lowest leads for batting K%, pitching ERA, FIP, WHIP, and pitching BB%. Ties share a rank.
methods.noise_note: Batting AVG, OBP, SLG, OPS, wOBA and pitching ERA remain below 0.60 split-half reliability at season sample sizes in the reliability study; treat small gaps as rough.

rate_formulas.woba: (wBB x uBB + wHBP x HBP + w1B x 1B + w2B x 2B + w3B x 3B + wHR x HR) / (AB + BB - IBB + SF + HBP)
rate_formulas.fip: (13 x HR + 3 x (BB + HBP) - 2 x SO) / IP + cFIP

methods.refresh: Box-score and rate cards update in the daily pipeline run and in evening score refreshes. Statcast Barrel% updates in the daily pipeline run. Each card shows its own through date.
methods.nulls: Values that cannot be supported are null with a reason; nothing is imputed or synthesised.
